remarks:
A Rare Opportunity to Create Your Own Private Estate! Welcome to 72.34 breathtaking acres in the desirable Town of Newstead, offering the highly sought-after Clarence Central School District while enjoying the advantage of Newstead’s lower property taxes. This exceptional property offers a spectacular blend of woods, open clearings, a picturesque stream, and a pond, creating a truly private, park-like setting where nature surrounds you.
Whether you envision building the estate of your dreams, creating a private equestrian retreat, or simply owning your own piece of the outdoors, the possibilities are endless. Hunters will appreciate the abundant wildlife and natural setting, while outdoor enthusiasts will enjoy the trails and opportunities to walk, explore, ride ATVs, or simply take in the peace and beauty of this remarkable property.
Utilities are available at the road, including public water, electric, telephone, cable, and high-speed internet, adding to the property’s appeal and potential for future development.
Tucked away from the hustle and bustle, yet conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, golf courses, and everyday amenities, this remarkable property offers the best of both worlds—seclusion and convenience. Enjoy an easy commute to Buffalo, Rochester, or Batavia while coming home to your own private sanctuary.
72.34 acres of privacy, natural beauty, recreation, and endless potential—build the estate of your dreams and create a lifestyle uniquely your own!
